name: Stellar Confluence
source:
In the year 2099, a colony ship embarks from a battered, increasingly uninhabitable Earth, headed for Proxima Centauri b. 

Thousands of passengers lie in cryosleep, waiting to be awoken at the end of the journey. 

Even in cryosleep, the minds of the passengers continue to think and to slowly dream. 

To protect their minds from the nightmares prolonged stasis can induce, the ship’s AI links pods of sleepers together in a shared dream network. 

The game follows two passengers, drifting through each other’s dreams with the help of the ship’s AI. 

As the women grow closer, the dreams become stranger, and less comforting. What’s gone wrong, and will they ever wake up?

[From [url=https://zenithvisions.itch.io/stellar-confluence]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
2099年，一艘殖民船从饱受摧残、越来越不适宜居住的地球出发，前往比邻星b。

数千名乘客处于冷冻睡眠状态，等待旅程结束时被唤醒。

即使在冷冻睡眠中，乘客的大脑仍然继续思考并慢慢做梦。

为了保护他们的思想免受长期停滞可能引发的噩梦的影响，船上的人工智能将睡眠者的舱群连接到一个共享的梦境网络中。

游戏讲述了两名乘客在船上人工智能的帮助下在彼此的梦境中漂流的故事。

随着两个女人的关系越来越亲密，梦境也变得越来越陌生，越来越不那么令人安慰。出了什么问题，他们会醒来吗？

[来自[url=https://zenithvisions.itch.io/stellar-confluence]itch.io[/url]]
